R.name: narrator R (the owner's own voice)
R.notes: 28.4 s of the owner's own narration, music-free (the owner's 'You Said What...' story, 2026-11-15). The owner's choice of the best voice; all other references deleted.
R.reference_text: Your teacher asks, what's the brightest thing in space? And you say, your shiny bald head, and everyone laughs. And your teacher gets so mad, but you didn't mean to say it. The words just came out. Your teacher sends you to the principal's office. The principal smiles and asks why you would say something like that. You try to explain that you didn't mean it, and it just slipped out. He says, that was a huge mistake. And you answer, not as huge as you, principal starts yelling, so you run out of the office as fast as you can. On the way home, you keep trying to figure out what's wrong with you. When you get home, you tell your dad everything that happened. He doesn't believe you, gets angry, and spanks your eye. You look at him and say, is that the best you've got? Even my little sister hits harder than you.

_note: Speaker N is the narrator. Voice ids are not secret keys, but keep them in this repo only.
